candidates.change_summary: Remove the super.supportsInterface(interfaceId) disjunct so IERC165 is no longer reported as supported.
Check for the IERC165 interface id instead of the IAccessControl interface id.
Replace the returned mapping lookup with constant true so hasRole always reports membership.
Replace the returned mapping lookup with constant false so hasRole never reports membership.
Negate the membership lookup so hasRole returns the inverse of the stored value.
Return the DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE constant instead of the stored adminRole for the role.
Return the queried role identifier itself instead of its stored adminRole.
